title: The Night Shift
description: Pinewood Estates Neighborhood Watch comes on Snazzie FM to recruit volunteers. Captain Glenda runs the cul-de-sac like a covert intelligence service. Tonight a man who just wanted to carry a flashlight discovers he's been issued a codename, a poison snack, and an extraction plan, and the harder he tries to quit, the more it proves he's the mole.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, we're doing our part. The Pinewood Estates Neighborhood Watch is here to recruit. If you want to keep your block safe, the lines are open.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Neighborhood watch. Okay. That's just people with flashlights, right? That's normal.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Thank you so much for having us, sweetheart. We're just a few caring neighbors keeping an eye on the theater. <p:0.3> The cul-de-sac, I mean. We call it the theater.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The theater. Now that's community pride, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Yeah, hi, I signed up Saturday? <p:0.3> At the table by the mailboxes. I just wanted to walk a flashlight around the block.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: And we're so glad you did, sweetheart. Did you drop your sign-up sheet in the third recycling bin like the instructions said?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: The... third bin. Yeah. Why the third one, specifically?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: The bin was a dead drop.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-ah] The bin was a WHAT?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Don't mind Winston, dear. He's been on the Watch since the eighties. <p:0.3> He just means we keep our paperwork tidy.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Okay, but then I got an envelope. <p:0.3> It says my codename is Nightingale Four. Why do I have a codename? I just signed up to WALK.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A codename. Ohhh, that's a nice touch. Makes a fella feel part of something.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, that's a cover identity.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Ooh, do I get a codename too? Is it like a club? Do I get a badge?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: You're Songbird Two, Linda dear. <p:0.3> Your badge is in the third bin.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Ooh! The bin! I love the bin!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: There was also a... a pretzel. In the envelope. In a little foil pouch that says, do not eat unless compromised.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: The pretzel is for if they take you.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: If they... if WHO takes me? It's a CUL-DE-SAC.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Glenda, did you issue that man a cyanide pretzel?

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: It's a trail snack, sweetheart. <p:0.3> For morale. We just ask that you don't share it, and you don't get captured.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Snacks AND a sense of purpose. That's a generous outfit, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Okay. Okay, you know what, I'd like to quit. <p:0.3> Effective tonight. I'm not an asset. I'm a guy with a flashlight.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart. <p:0.3> Nobody quits the Watch on the very night a mole would want to slip out. You see how that looks.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] I'm not a MOLE!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: That's what the last mole said.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There was a LAST mole?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: There's a vacancy on the cul-de-sac, Barry. <p:0.3> Number six. Lovely yard. Ask yourself why it's empty.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I am not asking myself that. I'm not. Glenda, take me off the roster.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Sweetheart, there's no off. There's only retirement. <p:0.3> And nobody comes back from retirement.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: Ooh, do we get a watch when we retire? My uncle got a watch!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: You don't get a watch, Linda.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Why is there a CAR outside my house. There's a car. It's just sitting there with the lights off.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's a neighbor keeping watch over a neighbor. Beautiful.

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Nightingale Four, listen to me very carefully now. <p:0.3> If you want out, you get yourself to the third recycling bin and you climb in. That's the extraction point.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: You want me to get INSIDE the bin?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Everything goes in the third bin.

lines.speaker: caller-linda
lines.text: The bin!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I am not getting in the bin!

lines.speaker: caller-glenda
lines.text: Then you're the mole, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Retire him.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: DO NOT RETIRE ME!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well folks, you heard it. Just good neighbors keeping an eye out for each other. <p:0.3> We'll be right back.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, they assigned that man a codename and a poison snack.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's a welcome basket, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: The basket was a dead drop.
